title: Desktop 单章场景边界 Run 绑定循环修复

commits.message: fix(desktop): scope scene boundary review to analysis run (CHG-20260917-001)

user_summary: 确保场景边界确认只作用于当前单章分析任务，避免旧任务与新任务交叉导致反复确认。
technical_summary: Scene boundary review is now scoped by analysis_run_id across overview, draft, split, save, restore, confirm, discard, and diff calls. The server validates Run/Chapter/Revision ownership and confirmation only supersedes revisions and journeys from the same AnalysisRun; legacy chapter-only reads remain compatible.
acceptance_criteria: A new analysis run on a chapter with an older confirmed run displays only the new run's model proposal.
Confirming the new run keeps the older run's confirmed boundary intact and advances the new run.
Revision mutations fail closed when the supplied analysis run does not own the revision.
tests: Desktop SceneBoundaryReviewPanel and BookRoute journey navigation: 30 passed
verification_evidence: 用户于 2026-09-20 明确授权将包含本修复的 StoryLens Desktop v1.3.8 作为正式 GitHub Release 发布；自动化回归和真实数据只读复现证据已记录。

data_compatibility.notes: No schema or data migration. Existing chapter-only callers retain the historical latest-revision behavior; the active Desktop workflow supplies analysis_run_id.
